name: local-forwarder
description: A local HTTP, HTTPS, and TZT forwarding service
author: Local Forwarder

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.package:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --x64 --publish never && node scripts/create-dmg.mjs && npm run verify:package
scripts.package:win:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:win
scripts.package:release:win:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:win && npm run verify:release:win
scripts.package:release:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir zip --x64 --publish never && node scripts/create-dmg.mjs && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:release:mac
